name: OAC 3745-33-08 Generic NPDES permit conditions (outfall signs; notice to public water supply operators)
status_reason: Ohio's only general rule touching public notice: permanent outfall signs, and notice to drinking-water intake operators near major discharges.
notes: (A)(12)(a) signs 'At each outfall authorized under the NPDES permit ... including ... bypass or combined sewer overflow discharges'; (b) permittee name, permit number, outfall number, contact telephone. (F)(1) majors within 3,000 ft of a lake intake or 10 river miles upstream of an intake must 'notify the public water supply operator as soon as practicable after a discharge begins that results from a spill, sanitary sewer overflow, bypass, upset, or combined sewer overflow'.

license: Item licence: 'This information is for display purposes only ... makes no warranties ... expressly disclaims any liability'.
